note: Fractions of traded value unless stated. Every component needs: rate, evidence_archived=true and a basis. basis HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE = archived evidence covers 2012-07-02..2026-09-01. basis CURRENT_RATE_ASSUMPTION = frozen protocol §13 fallback (current rate applied to the whole sample, labelled an assumption); it also needs assumed_for_period and why_history_unavailable. Anything else blocks every cost calculation (src/stage3/costs.py); nothing is ever treated as zero.

stt_buy.needed: official STT rate for delivery purchases, with history from 2012-07-01

stt_sell.needed: official STT rate for delivery sales, with history from 2012-07-01
